最近推特的账号策略我越发搞不懂了，姐妹 @web3_honey 的推特账号近期不幸被封，失去了超过一半的粉丝。

我见证了她从上一轮NFT周期开始，帮助BAYC在日本建立第一个社群，再到参与Azuki、Doodles等知名项目的建设。这一路走来，她所付出的努力和坚持，累积到了10万+粉丝并且跃升成为日本头部kol，极其不易。

她始终敏锐地把握着行业脉搏，从NFT到GameFi，再到AI，持续为许多海外项目搭建进入日本社区的桥梁。从Matr1x项目开始，我认识到她已成为日本市场的关键人物，虽说那时候没有合作，但我已经能看到，全球每一场区块链大会：东京，首尔，新加坡，吉隆坡，曼谷，马尼拉，河内，巴黎，香港，台北等等你都能看到她标志性红色头发的身影。今年我开始为Freestyle Classic举办线下活动，每一场她都亲自到场支持。这背后是常人难以想象的奔波与坚持。

日本市场建立社区和品牌绝非易事，懂的人都懂这里的门道非常深。但一旦建立信任，其社区的忠诚度与回报是惊人的。举个例子，当年Matr1x Fire的NFT和代币价格下跌时，全球其他社区没有一个不是抱怨的，但唯有日本社区创作了一幅《海贼王》风格的海报，象征着“旗帜未倒”的精神，令我感怀至今。

今年8月webx期间，我在虎之门艾迪逊举办了一场晚宴，honey帮我联系了8家餐厅和场地，并且帮我邀请了非常多的海外来宾，包括本土的几位大kol。于此同时，帮助我们与@syfuofficial 建立了非常好的联系。为FreeStyle Classic 接下来在日本发行NFT打下了坚实的基础。我在想，如果没有她的帮助，我都会缺乏勇气在日本举办私人晚宴，因为大多本地人社恐不愿意聚会，加之口语问题，很难完全取得信任和合作机会。

这一刻我明白了日本市场的独特性与珍贵性。因此，我坚信，任何项目若想进军日本，都需要一位本土代表塑造初印象、打通关键环节。我强烈推荐Web3Honey作为大使、顾问或咨询伙伴，助力项目落地日本。

在此，我诚挚呼吁大家关注她、支持她：

🎯活动1⃣️
📱请关注 @web3_honey 
🔥请务必在她的置顶推文下转发+留言
🎁她将抽取10位小伙伴，各赠送$100usdt

同时，我也为此加码，希望能让更多中文区小伙伴看见。
🎯活动2⃣️
📱请关注 @web3_honey 
🔥欢迎大家在本推文下回复“你在全球各地与Honey的合影或者鼓励她的话语”
🎁我将请她亲自选出5位小伙伴，由我私人再为每人赠送$100usdt

💰因此大家会有两次机会的概率获得奖金💰

我相信，Honey定能很快重回十万粉丝，并且会比以往更加闪耀。

她的价值，远不止于此。

I genuinely don’t understand Twitter’s account policies lately. My Sis @web3honey recently had her account suspended and lost more than half of her followers—just like that.

I’ve watched her journey from the very beginning: helping BAYC build its first community in Japan, contributing to iconic projects like Azuki and Doodles, and steadily growing to over 100K followers to become a top KOL in Japan. The persistence and effort behind this are truly not easy.

She has always had a sharp sense for where the industry is heading—from NFTs to GameFi to AI—consistently acting as a bridge for international projects entering the Japanese community. Since the Matr1x project, I’ve seen her become a key figure in the Japanese market. Even though we hadn’t collaborated back then, everyone could spot her iconic red hair at blockchain conferences around the world: Tokyo, Seoul, Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok, Manila, Hanoi, Paris, Hong Kong, Taipei… you name it. And this year, when I started organizing offline events for Freestyle Classic, she showed up to support me every single time. The energy and dedication behind that are beyond what most people realize.

Building a community and brand in Japan isn’t easy—those who’ve tried know how nuanced it is. But once you earn their trust, the loyalty and support you receive are incredible. Take Matr1x Fire, for example: when its NFT and token prices dropped, communities everywhere were filled with complaints—except in Japan. There, the community created a “One Piece”-themed poster symbolizing that “the flag never falls.” That left a deep impression on me, even to this day.

During WebX in August, I hosted a dinner at Toranomon Edition. Honey helped me scout and connect with 8 different venues and invited many overseas guests, including several major local KOLs. She also helped us build a solid relationship with @syfuofficial, laying a strong foundation for FreeStyle Classic’s upcoming NFT launch in Japan. Without her support, I wouldn’t have had the confidence to host a private dinner here—many locals tend to be reserved, and language barriers make it hard to quickly build trust and collaboration.

It was then that I truly understood what makes the Japanese market both unique and valuable. That’s why I firmly believe any project looking to enter Japan needs a local representative—someone who can shape that crucial first impression and open the right doors. I strongly recommend Web3Honey as an ambassador, advisor, or consultant to help bring projects successfully into Japan.

I sincerely hope you’ll join me in supporting her:

also Activity 1
✅ Follow @web3honey
🔄 Like & retweet her pinned tweet, and leave a comment
🎁 She will select 10 participants to each receive $100usdt

I’m also adding a personal incentive to help spread the word to more friends:
🎯 Activity 2
✅ Follow @web3honey
💬 Reply to this tweet with a photo of you and Honey from anywhere in the world, or leave words of encouragement for her
🎁 I will invite her to pick 5 participants personally, and I will reward each with $100 usdt

💰 That means you have TWO chances to win! 💰

I’m fully confident that Honey will not only regain her 100K followers but come back even stronger and brighter than before.

Her value goes far beyond what numbers can show.
